market.summary: Argentina has distinct national heritage and congressional institutions, municipal public networks, independent bibliotecas populares supported by CONABIP, and large university networks. Public discovery does not imply public borrowing. Koha has strong primary adoption evidence, Pérgamo serves major public/university deployments, and VuFind provides discovery over mixed systems. No national LMS market-share estimate is established.
market.platform_strategy: First scope a new Argentine Pérgamo adapter against the two verified substantial networks, then a deployment-specific UNS VuFind adapter with unknown-availability handling. Existing Koha code is a strategic reuse candidate but this sample produced no permitted, successful Koha book query. SIU BDU has the greatest cross-institution discovery potential; direct external search was rate-limited, so it is a research/partnership lead, not a ready connector. PMB BFA is a separately verified science-library option. Preserve edition and institution IDs.

limitations: No national largest-ten ranking established; dates and units are not comparable.
Four substantial institutions verified, six short of the target. Twenty-two blocked/unverified catalog cases retained.
No successful Koha book query in this sample; named migrations and DigiBepé adoption do not imply usable automation.
BDU source-record totals are harvested bibliographic counts, not holdings/copy totals or live circulation.
BFA title-query response includes related works; no claim to have retrieved Darwin’s requested title.
UNS backend failure is not an item availability state; UNNE copy status absent; CABA selected edition explicitly unavailable.
No authentication, holds, outreach, TLS bypass, bot-challenge bypass or app integration performed.
Transient anonymous form tokens and reflected network addresses redacted from retained raw response files; metadata marks any redaction.
